props.text:
The most beautiful love,
there is no end of time,there is no land,
just want to accompany you for life, that's all

The world puts off
its mask of vastness to its lover
It becomes small as one song
as one kiss of the eternal

The best love is the kind
that awakens the soul and makes us reach for more,
that plants a fire in our hearts and
brings peace to our minds."

Together we embark on a journey
With hands held and hearts entwined.
We face the road’s uncertainty
With love, our guiding light
Though paths may diverge, we choose to walk
Together, side by side
Our love will be our compass
To navigate this life’s ride

Laughing with you
Laugh at you
Like a dog; like a god

Love is not a matter of
counting the days
It’s making the days count.

Love does not consist in gazing at each other,
but in looking outward
together in the same direction.
